zh: 表目录左侧分类的圆点改为显示该分类下最严重的状态，颜色与右侧表格一致：红 = 异常 / 查询失败，橙 = 空表，灰 = 库里没有；鼠标悬停可看各状态张数。筛选栏右侧新增圆点颜色图例。
en: Category dots in the table catalog now show the worst status in that category, matching the table colours (red = anomaly / query failed, orange = empty, grey = missing), with per-status counts on hover. A colour legend was added beside the filters.
